name: G protein subunit alpha q

function.text: GNAQ encodes guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(q) subunit alpha. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in blood coagulation and bone resorption.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review. Postzygotic mosaic associations are recorded separately.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Uveal melanoma; Primary meningeal melanoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
